posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.content_md:
It seems that prices keep falling on these, they now have a 473nm, 5mW one at: [http://www.laserglow.com/bluepointer.html](http://www.laserglow.com/bluepointer.html) for $489. Prices will probably go down in the near future (based on what happened with green pointers).

I was wondering how short the coherence length is for green pointers, and how much variation there is. I'm pretty sure banded holograms result from green pointers, but I never tried one myself. Maybe blue pointers will be similar (?)

I don't know what the technology is for blue "diodes" at 473nm, or for this pointer in particular. Maybe they managed to make a miniature DPSS laser based on an infrared diode, enclosed in a diode package (?) or maybe there is a laser diode at that wavelength (?)

Anyway, this is a good example of how technology changes, maybe it will change to our benefit pretty soon

posts.content_md:
Joe, I think theese are frequency trippled dpss lasers. I am surprised thay are on the market as the alignments are more sensitive than the green dpss but I guess it was inevitable.

I don't have much hope for the coherence length but I would love to hear any results if you measure one.
